teams.title: Teams
teams.notFound: This team does not exist or you cannot see it.

create.title: New team
create.name: Team name
create.nameDescription: The name of the coordinator's session; renaming the session renames the team.
create.nameInvalid: A team name is at most {{max}} characters
create.baseBranchDescription: Where work merges back. Empty uses the project's default branch.

upgrade.title: Upgrade this session to a team
upgrade.intro: This session becomes the team's coordinator. Its conversation, working directory and sharing are kept; from the next message on it delegates the work to agents and tracks it on the team page.

errors.TEAM_ALREADY: This session is already a team coordinator.
errors.NARRATOR_EXECUTION_BUSY: The session is running or waiting. Try again once it is idle.
errors.TEAM_WORKSPACE_UNAVAILABLE: The session's working directory is not a local Git checkout of this project.
errors.TEAM_SESSION_OTHER_PROJECT: The session belongs to another project.
errors.TEAM_SESSION_KIND_UNSUPPORTED: This kind of session cannot become a team coordinator.
errors.TEAM_NAME_INVALID: Give the team a name of up to 120 characters.
errors.TEAM_PROJECT_NOT_GIT: The project's directory is not a local Git work tree.
errors.TEAM_BASE_BRANCH_UNRESOLVED: The base branch does not resolve to a commit in the project's repository. Enter an existing branch.
errors.TEAM_PROJECT_CHANGED: The project's directory or default branch changed meanwhile. Try again.

disband.title: Disband this team?
disband.confirm: The team's work items and its activity history are deleted. The coordinator's session and its conversation are kept and continue as an ordinary session; branches are not touched.
disband.done: Team disbanded; its session is kept

errors.TEAM_HAS_LIVE_WORK: The team still has unfinished work items or work items holding a worktree. Finish, cancel or clean them up first.
errors.NARRATOR_EXECUTION_BUSY: The coordinator is running or waiting. Try again once it is idle.

eventNote.syncNotDelivered: The worker did not get the instruction

top.pauseConfirm: This stops the current turn of every running session in this team: the coordinator and its agents. They keep their history and can be resumed by sending a message.
top.pauseNothing: Nothing was running; nothing was stopped
top.pauseMore: Stopped {{stopped}}; more were running than one pause reads, pause again
top.pauseError: Could not read the running sessions; nothing was stopped
top.archivedHint: This team is archived: its work items cannot change. Workers it started may still be running. Restore the coordinator's session to continue.

members.more: More people have access than are listed here.

empty.title: Work items show up here
empty.body: The coordinator splits the goal into work items, one branch each, each done by a worker. When one needs your approval, an answer or acceptance, it shows at the top under “Waiting on you”.
empty.placeholderDoing: What the worker is doing · lines changed

wrapUp.title: No open work items
wrapUp.bodyMerged: {{count}} branches are merged into {{base}}. To keep going, tell the coordinator on the left; if the team is done, archive it (every record is kept, read-only) or disband it.
wrapUp.body: Every work item is finished. To keep going, tell the coordinator on the left; if the team is done, archive it (every record is kept, read-only) or disband it.
wrapUp.held: {{count}} finished items still hold their worktree, so the team cannot be disbanded yet: ask the coordinator to clean them up (you approve each cleanup), or archive the team.

start.title: Tell the coordinator what this team should get done
start.body: Say the goal and the constraints. The coordinator splits it into work items, one branch each, and hands them to workers.

examples.upgrade: Upgrade a dependency to its new major version and drop the old compatibility code; one branch per step, reviewed before merging.
examples.issues: Go through the issues labelled bug: fix what can be fixed, and explain in the issue what can't.
examples.tests: Add unit tests to the modules under server/ that have none, up to 80% coverage.

drawer.loadFailed: Could not load this work item.
drawer.filesMore: More files changed than listed here
drawer.diffUnavailable: The changes can't be read now
drawer.barNote: NarraFork doesn't merge for you: once the branch is merged into {{base}}, this item is marked merged.
drawer.returnHint: The coordinator passes the reason to the worker; the item goes back to “In progress”.
drawer.returnedNotDelivered: Returned, but the coordinator could not be told; tell it in the conversation.
